mechanism: Olanzapine can cause weight gain and metabolic effects that may lead to hyperkalemia through insulin resistance and altered glucose metabolism; additionally, antipsychotics may affect potassium regulation through renal mechanisms.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels periodically in patients on olanzapine, particularly those with renal impairment, diabetes risk factors, or concurrent medications affecting potassium balance; assess baseline and periodic metabolic panels.
